noticias.titular: Astros owner: Playoff berth will factor into call on Espada
noticias.texto: Astros owner Jim Crane said Monday the team's playoff berth will be "something to consider" when deciding on the future of manager Joe Espada, whose contract expires after the season.

noticias.titular: Luis Arraez (ankle) won't be on Phillies' wild card roster
noticias.texto: Luis Arraez won't be on the Phillies' wild-card roster as he continues to recover from a sprained ankle he suffered late in the regular season.

noticias.titular: Misiorowski tops in ERA, K's; Alvarez, Moreno win batting titles
noticias.texto: Houston's Yordan Alvarez and Arizona's Gabriel Moreno won their first batting titles, while Brewers ace Jacob Misiorowski became just the fourth pitcher since 1950 to lead the majors in ERA, strikeouts and opponents' batting average.

noticias.titular: White Sox's Montgomery looks to 'positives,' not strikeout record
noticias.texto: Colson Montgomery wants to focus on the "positives" from his second year in the majors, not the single season strikeout record he broke on Friday.

noticias.titular: Astros win their 5th AL West title in the last 6 years, despite 81-81 record
noticias.texto: The Astros won their fifth AL West title in six years despite finishing with the worst record for a first-place team, beating the Athletics 9-0 Sunday behind Lucas Spence's two-run triple to finish at 81-81.
